subject: gk
question: The historical Somnath Temple, which was plundered several times by foreign invaders in ancient times, is located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Gujrat__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Somnath Mandir is located in **Gujrat**.
 
• **Mahmud Ghazni** looted the Somnath Temple in 1025 AD. 
 
• The Loot of this temple brought him immense wealth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Places that Mahmud of Ghazni invaded:**__

 
 
• ​Kabul.
 
• Delhi.
 
• Kanauj.
 
• Mathura.
 
• Kangra.
 
• Thaneshwar.
 
• Kashmir.
 
• Gwalior.
 
• Malwa.
